name: gifs
title: GIFs
description: Search Tenor or Giphy from the panel: a grid of animated previews, trending while nothing is typed. Enter puts the GIF file on the clipboard (it pastes as a picture), cmd+Enter copies its url, cmd+o opens the page, cmd+s saves it to Downloads, cmd+f keeps it in a Favourites grid.
author: pal

settings.label: Backend
settings.description: Where the GIFs come from; each needs its own free key.

settings.label: Tenor API key
settings.description: A Google Cloud API key with the Tenor API enabled on its project (console.cloud.google.com › APIs & Services › Enable APIs › Tenor API › Credentials). Free, no billing.

settings.label: Giphy API key
settings.description: From developers.giphy.com › Create an App (API, not SDK). Free; only read when the backend is Giphy.

settings.label: Content filter
settings.description: Tenor's `contentfilter` / Giphy's `rating`: what the results may show.

settings.label: Save to
settings.description: Where cmd+s writes the GIF, named after its title.

features: A grid of animated previews from Tenor (or Giphy), searched 300 ms after the last key; the trending list while nothing is typed
`enter` downloads the GIF and puts the file on the clipboard, so it pastes as a picture into Slack, Messages or a document; `cmd+enter` copies the url instead
`cmd+o` opens the GIF's page, `cmd+s` saves the file to Downloads (or `save_to`) named after its title, `cmd+f` keeps it in Favourites
Favourite GIFs is a grid of its own with the same actions and Remove; its rows are at the root, so a favourite is found by name
Previews and downloaded GIFs are cached under the user cache directory (`~/Library/Caches/pal/gifs`), so a second look or a second copy fetches nothing
At the root a query nothing matched offers “Search GIFs for …”

screenshots.caption: Nothing typed: Tenor's trending GIFs as a grid
cat typing: the results, the detail pane with the preview and the size
What a GIF can do: copy the file, copy the url, open, save, favourite
Without a key: one row saying where to get one

actions.title: Copy GIF
actions.description: Downloads the GIF into the cache and puts the file on the clipboard.

actions.title: Open in browser
actions.description: The GIF's page on tenor.com or giphy.com.

actions.title: Save to Downloads
actions.description: The file written to `save_to`, named after its title.

gifs.description: Type to search; nothing typed lists what is trending. Every tile is an animated preview; Enter copies the GIF file.

settings.label: Columns
settings.description: Tiles per row in both grids.

favourites.description: The GIFs kept with cmd+f, newest first; the same actions, and cmd+d removes one.
